owned_invariants: A ConstraintGraph never contains a self-loop, a duplicate vertex or a duplicate directed edge.
boundaries: Only the core constructs graphs; front ends reach them through contracts.to_graph.

score.level_basis: The declared carrier as an immutable, validated value: names, sizes, weights, self-loops and duplicates refused at construction, so no later code needs to re-check them; component decomposition used by the obstruction search.

basis.G1: AuthorityEffect: None and a unique URN; complete provenance envelope for the ported logic (pfp_lab/core/PROVENANCE.md: source path, git blob, committed SHA-256, last commit, a table of every change); the differential test maps every verdict field back to the unmodified source. Not A: no signed receipt of the source.
basis.G2: Exact profile: integer weights admitted bool-safely within 1..1000; structural invariants enforced on every construction path (frozen, slotted dataclasses). Not A: invariants are runtime-checked, not type-level.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Size bounds, refusals and component order are tested; immutability is tested. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 8, cognitive 10, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
